rationale.consistency: Adheres closely to the surrounding package conventions and seamlessly integrates into the Rewrite handler.
rationale.edge_cases: Backward parsing is semantically unsound, failing on %252F overlaps and aborting literal matches near invalid escapes.
rationale.scope: Strictly implements the required suffix matching logic with zero unrelated changes or dead code.
rationale.readability: The code is clearly structured and well-commented, making the flawed algorithm easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: Safe against bounds panics and handles invalid input gracefully, though it creates minor GC pressure in a hot loop.
rationale.maintainability: Parsing left-to-right encodings backward is a brittle anti-pattern; fixing the bugs requires a complete rewrite.
